Definition: a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8)
BiblicalUsage: The word names a joint of the hand, the knuckle, and it appears in two strange places. The false prophetesses sewed pillows to the armholes, and Ebed-melech told Jeremiah to put old rags under his armholes before they pulled him from the cistern.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the smallest joints of the body still matter to God, because He counts the rags under a prophet's arms.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
